verdict.rationale: The evidence says the product is a single logo-design skill packaged in the open Agent Skills format (a folder with a SKILL.md). It also says the agent picks the skill up from its description. Nothing shows a documented template or authoring guide for writing a new SKILL.md with name and description frontmatter. Using the format, or offering a packaging script, does not give developers a template for authoring their own skills.

support.subject: As a developer, I can author a new skill from a documented template — a SKILL.md with name and description frontmatter — without reverse-engineering existing skills
